cameraControls.title: Views

scope.label: Frame
scope.autoHint: Everything visible; the active site if the scene spans distant sites
scope.groupHint: Every model in the active model's group
scope.allHint: All visible models and point clouds

cameraControls.narrowed: Scene spans distant sites — framing the active one.
cameraControls.empty: Nothing visible to frame. Show a model or point cloud first.

info.title: Model Info
info.sizeUnavailable: Size unavailable — model was loaded from the OPFS cache. Reload from disk to see file size.

sizeTip.tiny: Very small file — loads instantly on any device.
sizeTip.normal: Typical IFC file. Good performance on modern hardware.
sizeTip.large: Large file. Loading may take longer. OPFS cache will help on repeat opens.
sizeTip.heavy: Very large file. Consider splitting the model or using LOD techniques for better performance.

elementTip.typical: Typical building model. Smooth interaction on desktop.
elementTip.complex: Complex model. Interaction may feel slower on lower-end GPUs.
elementTip.dense: Extremely dense model. Consider LOD or splitting by discipline.

rendererTip.webgpu: WebGPU renderer active — maximum performance available on this device.
rendererTip.webgl: WebGL renderer. WebGPU is not available in this browser.

section.title: Section
section.clickHint: Click any model surface to place a clipping plane aligned to its face normal.
section.boxHint: Select one or more elements to box them in.

floorPlan.title: Floor Plans
floorPlan.noStoreys: No storeys found in this model.

scene.title: Scene
scene.clickHint: Click a model to activate · use ⊙ to isolate

group.moveTogetherHint: Move every file of this building as one, keeping their alignment

tree.emptyGroup: Empty group: drag models or clouds here

scope.label: Scope
scope.groupHint: Move the active file's group (IFC and clouds) as one block
scope.sceneHint: Move everything loaded (IFC and clouds) as one block

rigid.pivotHint: Plan centre at the lowest level. Changing it moves the whole set without breaking its alignment.
rigid.heading: heading {{deg}}°
rigid.geoHint: The map is anchored to this set: moving it here does not change its lat/lon. To calibrate lat/lon and heading, use the location editor.
rigid.resetHint: Return every member to its original position

history.temporaryHint: Move freely, then go back to how it was
history.temporaryOn: Temporary changes: they will be undone on restore.

transform.snapToGridHint: Move model so its bottom sits on the Y=0 grid plane and is centred on X/Z
transform.resetHint: Reset all transform values to identity

renderQuality.title: Render Quality
renderQuality.ssaoNote: SSAO + edge detection active. May impact performance on mobile.
renderQuality.qualityHint: Quality — SSAO ambient occlusion + edge detection post-processing

cache.tooltip: {{count}} model(s) cached in OPFS · click to clear

fm.tip: FM handover readiness: {{score}}/100 (COBie completeness — not an official certification)

walk.title: Walk mode
walk.hint: WASD move · drag to look · Q/E height · Shift run · double-click to go
walk.hintTouch: Stick to move · drag to look · double-tap to go
